character: Rimwatch is the rangers' post on the Rift's lip: a dog and an owl on watch, a bird in the gutter, and three small Pokemon on the rail who watch the Rift for reasons of their own. No pets: the post places no ranger or keeper for one to belong to.

workers.interact: The rangers' Growlithe watches the Rift without blinking. When you move, it watches you too.
The Noctowl keeps the night watch over the Rift, turning its head round the whole way and back. The rangers write down what it looks at.

placed.why: in the north cabin's gutter, out of the wind that comes up out of the Rift

situations.title: The three on the overlook rail
situations.story: Every evening a Rockruff, a Shinx and a Pawmi sit in a row at the overlook end of the square and stare down into the Rift. The rangers have never found out what they are waiting for.
situations.why: Rimwatch's own: the square's east end, at the overlook, facing the Rift
